script: Hi, it's Joe from WDI. We put together something for Southern Gas Supplies that I think you'll like.
Right now your trade customers are probably ringing or texting to check prices and stock codes. Here's what it looks like when they can look it up themselves.
Your customer logs in to their own trade account.
They see their own pricing straight away.
They can search your full range by product name, stock code or category.
Every product shows their trade price, with better rates when they buy in quantity.
They pick what they need, choose delivery or collection, and send the order.
Next week, they hit reorder and it's done in seconds.
And your team gets a staff desk where every order lands clean. No missed calls, no scribbled notes.
This is your portal, with your branding, ready to go live.
